row.name: K. D. Wesley Summer Youth Program

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: During the visit, two staff members with pending background checks were present, and one volunteer staff member, who is present twice a week to teach a class, did not have a background check. In total, there were three individuals without completed background checks.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Fenced Outdoor Activity Space: During the visit, the operation did not have an enclosed playground for children under 5.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fenced Outdoor Activity Space (26 TAC §746.4305)

occurrences.finding: Caring for Children Above or Below Ground Level-Written Approval: During the initial monitoring visit, there were three school-age children upstairs providing assistance in the office. The three school-age children were helping prep for activities for upcoming events.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Caring for Children Above or Below Ground Level-Written Approval (26 TAC §746.4217(1))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: During the visit, there was one individual with a pending background check who had direct access to children in care at the operation. Another individual had direct access to children in care without a background check.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually: Three caregivers did not have transportation training certificates available for review during the monitoring visit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually (26 TAC §746.1316(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Medical Authorization: Six out of ten children did not have the emergency medical authorization section completed by the parent on the admission form.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Physician Information (26 TAC §746.605(11))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity: During the monitoring visit, the parent handbook did not have the section for promotion of play that explained the purpose of play, duration, and how many times the children go outside.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity (26 TAC §746.501(a)(18))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check determination - If ineligible then you must immediately remove subject from operation and confirm to CBCU receipt of notice letter: Upon arrival, there was one employee whose background check was ineligible. The employee left the operation at the director's request. I observed the employee clock out and leave the building.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check determination - If ineligible then you must immediately remove subject from operation and confirm to CBCU receipt of notice letter (26 TAC §745.635(2))

occurrences.finding: Medication Authorization - Signed and Dated: During the monitoring visit, two children did not have the medical authorization form signed by the parent. The medication is stored at the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Medication Authorization - Signed and Dated (26 TAC §746.3803(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Fenced Outdoor Activity Space: During the monitoring visit, the operation did not have an enclosed fence around the outdoor play area for children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fenced Outdoor Activity Space (26 TAC §746.4305)

occurrences.finding: Napping Floor Mats Marked with Sleeping Side Distinguished: During the monitoring visit, the operation did not have the mats labeled to determine what size is for the floor and the side they sleep on.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Napping Floor Mats Marked with Sleeping Side Distinguished (26 TAC §746.4503(c))

occurrences.finding: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering: During the monitoring visit, I observed the classroom using the restroom, and after toileting, they exited the bathroom to sit on the wall, and the caregiver administered hand sanitizer instead of handwashing in the restroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering (26 TAC §746.3417(3))

occurrences.finding: Outdoor Activity Space Accessible By Safe Route or get required approval of plan: The operation did not have a written plan on how children are transported to the outdoor play area not connected to the building.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Outdoor Activity Space Accessible By Safe Route or get required approval of plan (26 TAC §746.4311)

occurrences.finding: Annual Sanitation Inspection: During the monitoring visit, the operation did not have an annual sanitation inspection report available for review during the monitoring visit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Sanitation Inspection (26 TAC §746.3401(a))

occurrences.finding: Provide Parents With Copy of Policies: 10 out of 10 children files did not have the operational parent handbook signed by the parent.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Provide Parents With Copy of Policies (26 TAC §746.503)

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Water Activity Permission: 10 out of 10 children files did not have the water activity section completed on the on line application to review during the monitoring visit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Physician Information (26 TAC §746.605(10))

occurrences.finding: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually: The director and two caregivers who transport children did not complete two hours of transportation training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually (26 TAC §746.1316(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit: 10 out of 10 staff members did not have the affidavit form notarized available for review during the montiroing visit or the pre-employment affidavit form available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §746.901(4))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: 5 out of 10 children did not have an emergency contact section completed on the online application.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §746.605(6))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: 10 out of 10 children files did not have a shot record available to review during the monitoring visit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity: The operation did not have the physical promotion section in the parent handbook.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity (26 TAC §746.501(a)(18))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking.: 4 out of 10 staff members did not complete CPR/first aid training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking. (26 TAC §746.1315(a))

occurrences.finding: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional: The operation did not have food allergy forms for seventeen children signed by the parent and the physician.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional (26 TAC §746.3819)

occurrences.finding: AP Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Ensure No Child Abused, Neglected, or Exploited: This standard was found deficient as part of a DFPS investigation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Ensure No Child Abused, Neglected, or Exploited (26 TAC §746.1201(4))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: This standard was found deficient as part of a DFPS investigation. Based on information obtained during a DFPS investigation, a violation was found. The caregiver left a five-year-old child who is autistic unattended at the front of the operation without notifying staff or other caregivers. The child left the operation unsupervised and was in the parking lot for about 45 minutes. The child was found at the front door of the operation with no shoes.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Field Trips - Signed Permission: I was not able to review field trips and transportation forms for ten children during the monitor visit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Field Trips - Signed Permission (26 TAC §746.3001(1))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: The four caregivers left the operation during the monitoring visit since their background checks were not complete.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Notify Parents of Change in Operational Policy or Enrollment Agreement: The operation did not have the relocation address, name, or phone number listed for parents in the parent operational policy book under the emergency preparedness plan section. Information was added during the monitoring visit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Notify Parents of Change in Operational Policy or Enrollment Agreement (26 TAC §746.505(2))

occurrences.finding: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional: The operation did not have food allergy forms for seventeen children signed by the parent and the physician.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional (26 TAC §746.3819)

occurrences.finding: Annual Sanitation Inspection: The operation did not have a current health inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Sanitation Inspection (26 TAC §746.3401(a))
